name: dot-matrix
title: Dot matrix
description: A grid of dots that grow with the value, such as payments per weekday and hour, with a now cell, keyboard reading and a table for screen readers.

props.name: data
props.description: The values, one array per row with one number per column: `data[row][column]`. Missing cells count as 0.

props.name: rows
props.description: The short row names at the left: "Mon" or "M".

props.name: rowTitles
props.description: The full row names for the tooltip, the table and screen readers: "Mon", "Monday". Default `rows`.

props.name: columns
props.description: The short column names along the bottom: "07", "08".

props.name: columnTitles
props.description: The full column names for the tooltip, the table and screen readers: "07:00–08:00". Default `columns`.

props.name: label
props.description: The chart's accessible name, such as "Card payments per hour over the last 4 weeks".

props.name: format
props.description: How values are written in the tooltip, the table and when read. Default a plain whole number.

props.name: levels
props.description: The upper bounds of levels 0 to 3, ascending; anything above the last is the top level. The mockup's `[0, 1, 3, 5]` puts 0 at the smallest dot, 1 next, 2–3, 4–5 and 6 or more at full size. Default: 0, then quarters of the largest value.

props.name: current
props.description: The cell marked as now in --primary, as `row * columns.length + column`. Default null, none.

props.name: labelEvery
props.description: Name every nth column, counted from the first. Default as many as fit, at most about six.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show breathing skeleton dots instead of data.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown over the empty grid when there is no data or every value is 0, such as a message and a next step.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: The highlighted cell as `row * columns.length + column`, or null. Pass it to control the highlight.

props.name: defaultActiveIndex
props.description: The highlighted cell to start with, when `activeIndex` is not controlled. Default null.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Called when hover, a finger or the keyboard picks another cell, and with null when it lets go.

props.name: density
props.description: "compact" draws smaller, flatter cells. Inside a compact DataTile this happens on its own.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every visible and spoken string that is not data.

a11y.text: The grid is one Tab stop. Arrows move in both axes, Home and End go to the ends of a row, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End to the corners, and Escape lets go.

The grid is an image named by label with a hint. Each step is read once as row, column and value, with "now" (labels.current) on the current cell. A hidden table holds the data, and the dots differ in size and darkness so the pattern reads without colour.
Under reduced motion every dot is at its size at once.
